card.name: Volume and ID numbers in citations
card.fires_on: The punctuation, space or first digit just before a volume, page or ISBN number in reference lists. It fires after "v.", "ISBN", a journal abbreviation or a year with a semicolon.

modes.label: Before ISBN digits
modes.description: The space or first digit right after ISBN or SBN in a book citation.

modes.label: Journal volume slot
modes.description: The period, space or digit where a journal volume or issue number begins.
